d:
Some love stories never end… They transcend time and last longer than just a lifetime!
"Janam Janam" encapsulates the timeless love story between Shah Rukh Khan & Kajol in the enchanting world of Dilwale.
The poignant lyrics penned by Amitabh Bhattacharya beautifully convey the emotions of a love that knows no bounds. Arijit Singh & Antara Mitra's soulful rendition, combined with Pritam's evocative music, elevates this song to a realm of pure magic.
Song Credits
Song Name – Janam Janam
Movie – Dilwale 2015
Singer – Arijit Singh; Antara Mitra
Lyrics – Amitabh Bhattacharya
